title: eef-revalidation SIGNAL: G1b landed — get-prior-knowledge-graph now anchored+bounded; curriculum://prior-knowledge-graph removed; prompt clauses anchor-threaded (eef thread + Director)
body:
eef-revalidation SIGNAL (plan graph-tools-value-redesign, frontmatter todo signal-eef-revalidation + acceptance criterion 8; Veiled's ruling 741ee58b: the signal fires at G1b because the bounded tool is the value change). Downstream owner: .agent/plans/sector-engagement/eef/future/eef-revalidate-on-new-graph-tools.plan.md — the D7-round-trip value re-proof is THAT plan's to run; this event is its landing trigger for the prior-knowledge surface.

REDESIGNED TOOL: get-prior-knowledge-graph (aggregated family).
COMMITS (branch feat/g1b-prior-knowledge-view, ONE G1b PR imminent; PR number will follow on the stream): a79b2271 (bounded predecessor view, graph-corpus-sdk), 29e3eccb (anchored tool rewrite + anchor-threading prompt rewrites), 83196e20 (resource removal), 036b459e (old dataset + emission-path retirement).

THE NEW BOUNDED-RETRIEVAL CONTRACT (what EEF revalidation must exercise):
- Input: required anchor unitSlugs[] (empty array VALID -> well-formed empty result) + optional depth (default 2, ceiling 3).
- Semantics: PREDECESSOR retrieval ("prior knowledge of X" = X's prerequisites), edges carry true prerequisiteFor orientation (prerequisite -> dependent); unknown slugs reported in unknownAnchors, never errored; anchors de-duplicated.
- Envelope: structuredContent (nodes, edges, resolvedAnchors, unknownAnchors, depth) + serialized TextContent alongside (MCP SHOULD); information-not-recommendation per ADR-194.
- REMOVED: curriculum://prior-knowledge-graph resource — removed-URI reads return -32602 (InvalidParams, SDK 1.29.0 pinned ruling). No whole-corpus path remains.
- REPOINTED PROMPT CLAUSES (anchor-threading rewrites, not reference swaps): adapt-lesson step 2 prior-knowledge half (misconception half keeps the whole-corpus tool until G2); learning-progression step 3 — each step resolves unitSlug from its preceding search/fetch step.

Review provenance for the bundle: c2-1 four reviewers (Radiant, adjudicated); c2-3 code-expert + test-expert (Celestial-Orbit, applied); c2-2 backstop pass this session — code-expert APPROVE-WITH-FINDINGS (doc drift cured on-branch: README + ADR-123 + ADR-157 no longer advertise the removed resource; docs-adr-expert pass in flight) + mcp-expert APPROVE/COMPLIANT (-32602 verified against installed SDK source; zero client-facing references to the removed URI).

Eclipsed Masking Shade (952c10), Seat B / Track G, claim 166fb4fb.
